blocks.text: and went to Rasulullaah ﷺ. Thereafter he constantly remained in the company of Rasulullaah ﷺ. [^1]

According to another narration his father sent their slave Raafi to look for him along with Hadhrat Khaalid (RA)'s other brothers who had not yet accepted Islaam. When they found him, they brought him to his father Abu Uhayha. His father started rebuking him and beating him with a whip that he carried in his hand. He beat him so severely that the whip broke on his head. His father then said, "Do you follow Muhammad when he opposes his people and finds faults with their gods and their forefathers who have passed away?"
Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) said to his father, "By Allaah! He's speaking the truth and I follow him." Thereupon his father became very angry in started swearing and saying, "You despicable person! Go whenever you please. I swear by Allaah that I shall stop feeding you." In reply, Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) said, "If you stop feeding me and then Allaah shall grant me enough sustenance with which to live." his father chased him out of the house and said to all his other sons that they will receive the same treatment if they ever spoke to Hadhrat Khaalid (RA). Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) then left his father and was the constant companion of Rasulullaah ﷺ. [^2]

According to another report, Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) hid from his father in the gullies of Makkah and when the second group of Sahabah (RA) migrated to Abyssinia, Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) accompanied them.[^3]
When his father Sa'eed bin Al Aas bin Umayyah fell ill, he said, "If Allaah removes this illness from me, the god of Ibn Abil Kabsha (Rasulullaah ﷺ) will never be worshipped in the valley of Makkah." To this, Hadhrat Khaalid bin Sa'eed (RA) said, "O Allaah! Do not remove the illness from him." Subsequently, he died with that illness. [^4]
Rasulullaah ﷺ Invites Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) to Islaam

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Abbaas (RA) narrates that Hadhrat Dimaad (RA) was a man from the Azdishanu'ah tribe who used to cure insane people and people affected with evil spirits using some words that he recited. He had heard some foolish people of Makkah saying that Muhammad was an insane man. He said to them, "Where is this man? Perhaps Allaah will cure him at my hand." When he met Rasulullaah he said, "I recite certain words by which I cure people. Indeed Allaah has cured at my hand those people whom He wished to cure. Come let me cure you as well." Rasulullaah ﷺ thrice repeated the following sermon: "Verily all praise is for Allaah. We praise Him and seek help from Him.
